answer: To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 15 epochs old, anchored at a pulse checkpoint. The glacier chain is verified at intake and shale publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 15 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. The attacker spends 33 dollars and 18 days per identity before it can vote at all. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
